svg.title: K07: A healthy app that keeps getting killed
svg.desc: The liveness probe starts checking at 5 seconds and allows a single failure. The app needs about 20 seconds to start, so it is killed before it can answer, every time.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
